key.name: location
key.description: Show a dedicated panel button with its own popup, or embed the card in the Quick Settings menu.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which part of the top panel holds the button.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Order of the button within the chosen panel area.

key.name: indicator-visibility
key.description: Always, only while a media player is running, or never. In the Quick Settings mode the card stays reachable there even with never.

key.name: hide-builtin-media
key.description: Remove GNOME's own media player entry from the notification list so the card is not shown twice. Restored as soon as the extension is turned off.

key.name: card-layout
key.description: With several players one card is open and the rest are single rows, or always full cards, or always compact ones.

key.name: panel-text-fixed
key.description: Keep the full width even for a short track, so nothing next to the text moves between songs.

key.name: panel-controls
key.summary: Show the controls in the panel
key.description: Put previous, play and next next to the icon, so a track can be changed without opening the card.

key.name: cover-size
key.description: How large the album art is drawn in a full-size card.

key.name: show-volume
key.description: Only shown for players that report a volume of their own.

key.name: show-loop-shuffle
key.summary: Show the shuffle and repeat buttons
key.description: Only shown for players that support them.

key.name: scroll-text
key.summary: Scroll text that does not fit
key.description: Move a long title sideways instead of cutting it off.

key.name: panel-scroll
key.description: What the mouse wheel does over the button: nothing, switch tracks, or change the player volume.

key.name: panel-middle-click
key.summary: Middle click on the panel button

key.name: panel-text
key.description: Show the title, the artist and the title, or nothing but the icon.

key.name: panel-text-width
key.description: Longest the panel text may get, in pixels. Anything beyond it scrolls.

key.name: ignored-players
key.description: Names of players that get no card, matched against the app id, the bus name and the name the player reports.
